minor.issue: Returns 403 Forbidden for admin JWT (login as saskstartupsolutions@viciconsulting.ca). DELETE /api/bookings/{id} works (200) with same token — inconsistent authz.

ui_bugs.issue: Admin (/admin) and Portal (/portal) render BOTH 'index, follow' (from static index.html) AND 'noindex, nofollow' (from Helmet) meta robots tags. Browsers/crawlers typically use the first one found (index, follow) → risk of these pages being indexed. Static tag lacks data-rh attribute so Helmet appends instead of replacing.

Every route has TWO meta[name=description] (first = static site-wide, second = per-route from Seo.jsx), TWO link[rel=canonical] (first always homepage, second = per-route), TWO og:title / og:description. First one wins for most crawlers → per-route canonical and description are effectively ignored by SEO consumers that read the first match.

Two page_view events are pushed to dataLayer for '/' on initial mount (dev build). Likely React.StrictMode double-invokes the useEffect. In production the duplicate may be gone, but recommend using a ref/guard or verifying the production build.

action_items: Remove the SEO-related meta tags from frontend/public/index.html that Seo.jsx also controls (meta robots, link canonical, meta description, og:title/description/url, twitter:title/description) so react-helmet-async is the single source of truth per route. Keep static og:image (optional), og:site_name and gtag snippet. This fixes BOTH the admin/portal noindex leak and the duplicate description/canonical tags.
Investigate duplicate page_view on initial load (likely React.StrictMode in dev). Add a useRef guard in AnalyticsTracker or confirm production build only fires once.
Make DELETE /api/contacts/{id} consistent with DELETE /api/bookings/{id} (both should allow admin token). Currently contacts returns 403 for authenticated admin.
critical_code_review_comments: Seo.jsx is correct, but Helmet does not replace static index.html meta tags lacking data-rh — this is the root cause of per-route canonical/description/robots duplication. The static tags should not duplicate what Helmet manages.

backend/server.py L869-874: DELETE /api/bookings/{id} relies solely on get_current_user; contacts endpoint behaves differently (403) — audit the dependency on both to ensure consistent admin-only semantics.
AnalyticsTracker useEffect has no guard against StrictMode double-invocation — recommend a mounted ref.

context_for_next_testing_agent: After main agent removes duplicate SEO tags from public/index.html, re-verify: (1) only ONE meta[name=robots] per page, with noindex,nofollow on /admin and /portal; (2) only ONE link[rel=canonical] whose href matches the current route (e.g. /services → canonical ends in /services); (3) only ONE meta[name=description] matching per-page Seo.jsx. Also re-check that /, /services, /booking, /staff, /contact, /faq, /blog, /sitemap, and /blog/<slug> each have unique canonical/description/og:title. Use the earlier Playwright snippet: `Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('meta[name=description], link[rel=canonical], meta[name=robots]')).map(x=>({tag:x.tagName, name:x.getAttribute('name')||x.getAttribute('rel'), v:x.content||x.href}))` — the array length per tag type must equal 1.
rca of the issue: react-helmet-async only replaces tags it previously injected (identified by its own data-rh attribute). Static tags written in public/index.html for the SAME meta name / link rel are left in the DOM, resulting in duplicates. For meta[name=robots] specifically, the FIRST tag (static 'index, follow') overrides the semantics intended for /admin and /portal where Helmet injects a second 'noindex, nofollow'. Fix: remove the per-route-controlled tags from index.html, OR add react-helmet-async's SSR hydration pattern, OR delete the static robots/canonical/description server-side before serving the shell.
